parse_exclusions.meaning: YAML parse failures remain outside the parsed denominator; they are not actor absence observations.

legacy_untyped_census.meaning: The frozen parsed legacy untyped inventory contains no actor parent or nested actor.id; this bounded absence is not a claim that legacy provenance never existed.

memberships.effective_meaning: Record-local provenance slot for activity associated with creating or recording a memory-admission assessment; the selected evidence does not settle the activity or actor class.
exceptions: decision_authority_ref and operator_acceptance.actor_ref are separate fields and are not populated by actor.
The synthetic example has no actor parent, while the template has an object with null children.
memberships.disposition: Preserve the absent versus object/null states and leave event, identity class, requiredness and authority unresolved.

memberships.effective_meaning: Record-local provenance slot for activity associated with preparing or recording a preservation decision; the template does not establish whether this is the decider, recorder or another actor.
exceptions: operator_acceptance_ref and operator_review_required are separate preservation fields.
Template-only object/null evidence does not establish requiredness or an actor class.
memberships.disposition: Retain the template object/null state and do not infer operator acceptance, source authorship or decision authority.

memberships.effective_meaning: Record-local provenance slot for activity associated with creating, revising or reviewing a relationship edge; the selected evidence does not identify which activity occurred.
exceptions: The synthetic edge is directed and has endpoints, but its absent actor does not affect endpoint or relation semantics.
Endpoint identity, direction, source support and warrant are not actor identity.
memberships.disposition: Preserve object/null versus absent and leave the actor event, identity class and authority unresolved.

memberships.effective_meaning: Record-local provenance slot for activity associated with recording or inspecting a source location; locator address and resolution observation remain distinct from actor.
exceptions: The locator template's request to report who inspected or reported a location does not prove that actor is the addressed resource, source author or a successful resolver.
Only template object/null evidence is present.
memberships.disposition: Retain object/null and leave the activity, identity class, resolution status and requiredness unresolved.

memberships.effective_meaning: Record-local provenance attribution on a source-support record; the four populated pilot records carry codex-cc with extractor and agent-direct labels, but those labels do not settle principal identity or the exact support activity.
exceptions: subject_ref identifies a supported claim and source_ref identifies a source; neither is the actor.
The populated records are candidate support/extraction observations with verification and admission unassessed.
memberships.disposition: Preserve the exact populated labels and template null state; do not infer source author, supported-claim actor, semantic verifier or truth authority.

memberships.effective_meaning: Record-local provenance slot for activity associated with a validation result; the selected template does not establish whether it is the validator, recorder or another participant.
exceptions: validator_identity is a distinct validation-result field and no equality or precedence is evidenced.
Only template object/null evidence is present.
memberships.disposition: Retain the object/null state and leave the activity, relationship to validator_identity, identity class and requiredness unresolved.

memberships.effective_meaning: Identity child of the memory-admission actor mapping; selected state is null in the template and not applicable because the synthetic example omits the parent.
exceptions: Root record id, decision_authority_ref, operator_acceptance.actor_ref and target_refs do not supply actor.id.
memberships.disposition: Preserve null versus parent-absent/not-applicable and do not derive a principal from admission, authority or target fields.

memberships.effective_meaning: Identity child of the preservation-decision actor mapping; selected state is the template null placeholder.
exceptions: prior_refs, destination_refs and operator_acceptance_ref identify preservation material or review, not actor.id.
memberships.disposition: Retain the null child and do not infer a decider, operator or source author identity.

memberships.effective_meaning: Identity child of the relationship-edge actor mapping; selected state is null in the template and not applicable because the synthetic edge omits the parent.
exceptions: from_ref, to_ref, relation direction and source_support_refs identify edge content or warrant, not actor.id.
memberships.disposition: Preserve null versus parent-absent/not-applicable and do not infer endpoint, relation or support authority.

memberships.effective_meaning: Identity child of the source-locator actor mapping; selected state is the template null placeholder.
exceptions: source_ref, resource, locator_value and prepared/original mappings identify addressed material or coordinates, not actor.id.
memberships.disposition: Retain the null child and do not infer source identity, resource ownership or resolution identity.

memberships.effective_meaning: Recorded actor label child on four candidate pilot source-support records; all populated values are codex-cc, with four template/null records across the selected set.
exceptions: codex-cc is a bounded label in these records, not evidence of a unique human, model, tool, process or global principal.
subject_ref/source_ref and the claim-support body do not establish actor identity or authority.
memberships.disposition: Preserve exact spelling, parent state, record kind and revision context; do not normalize or map the label to source authorship, verification or admission.

memberships.effective_meaning: Identity child of the validation-result actor mapping; selected state is the template null placeholder.
exceptions: validator_identity is a separate slot; target_refs and contract_ref do not identify actor.id.
memberships.disposition: Retain the null child and leave actor identity and its relation to validator_identity unresolved.

actor-memory-admission.definition: A record-local provenance attribution associated with a memory-admission assessment. The evidence does not decide whether it denotes authoring, extraction, review, recording or another activity.
actor-memory-admission.applicability: Only the root actor mapping on a memory-admission record; not decision authority, operator acceptance, target identity, evidence grade or runtime write.
actor-memory-admission.observed: The template has actor as an object with id/mode/role null; the synthetic memory-admission example omits actor. No populated native actor occurs.

operational_consequences.reader: Show absent and object/null as explicit provenance limits; do not label actor as the decider or operator.
operational_consequences.extractor: Preserve actor separately from decision_authority_ref and operator_acceptance.actor_ref.
operational_consequences.query: Scope actor lookup to memory-admission record kind and revision; absence is not a null child match.
operational_consequences.migration: Preserve parent and child states and do not manufacture actor from target or acceptance fields.

unresolved_questions: What activity does a populated memory-admission actor denote?
What evidence permits actor.id to identify a decision authority or distinguishes that authority from the recording actor?
actor-memory-admission.disposition: Inventory interpretation only; retain states and defer actor event, class, authority and requiredness.

actor-preservation-decision.definition: A record-local provenance attribution associated with a preservation decision. The template leaves the actual participant and activity open.
actor-preservation-decision.applicability: Only the root actor mapping on a preservation-decision record; not operator review, operator acceptance, prior value, destination or reconciliation.
actor-preservation-decision.observed: The only selected mapping is the preservation-decision template with an object/null actor.

operational_consequences.reader: Render the explicit null provenance state without naming an operator or decider.
operational_consequences.extractor: Keep actor distinct from operator_acceptance_ref and operator_review_required.
operational_consequences.query: Join actor only within the preservation-decision revision; do not treat destination or prior refs as actor.
operational_consequences.migration: Carry object/null and any future populated label without assigning authority by shape.

unresolved_questions: Does a populated actor identify the preservation decider, the recorder, or another participant?
When is operator review required for this actor-bearing record, if at all?
actor-preservation-decision.disposition: Template-only bounded finding; no actor authority or requiredness rule is adopted.

actor-relationship-edge.definition: A record-local provenance attribution associated with creating, revising or reviewing a relationship edge; the selected evidence does not identify which event occurred.
actor-relationship-edge.applicability: Only the edge record actor; not endpoint identity, direction, symmetry, relation meaning, support or warrant.
actor-relationship-edge.observed: The template has object/null actor; the synthetic directed edge example omits actor.

operational_consequences.reader: Show actor as unresolved/absent separately from edge endpoints and source support.
operational_consequences.extractor: Do not copy endpoint, source-support or run identity into actor.
operational_consequences.query: Scope actor to the edge revision; an edge lookup must not treat actor as an endpoint.
operational_consequences.migration: Preserve absent versus object/null and never create a reciprocal actor from a symmetric relation.

unresolved_questions: What edge activity is represented by a populated actor?
What evidence would distinguish an edge author from a semantic reviewer or support recorder?
actor-relationship-edge.disposition: Retain states and leave event, identity class and authority unresolved.

actor-source-locator.definition: A record-local provenance attribution associated with recording or inspecting a source location; address and resolution observation remain separate.
actor-source-locator.applicability: Only the source-locator record actor; not source identity, addressed-resource identity, source authorship or locator resolution.
actor-source-locator.observed: The only selected mapping is the source-locator template with object/null actor.

operational_consequences.reader: Display an unresolved locator actor separately from resource and locator coordinates.
operational_consequences.extractor: Record who inspected/reported a location only when direct evidence exists; do not infer it from source_ref.
operational_consequences.query: Separate actor lookup from resource and resolution queries; address match is not actor match.
operational_consequences.migration: Retain null and future labels without converting them into source or resource identity.

unresolved_questions: Does a populated locator actor denote the inspector, recorder, resolver or another participant?
What evidence establishes resolution rather than merely recording a coordinate?
actor-source-locator.disposition: Template-only bounded finding; activity, identity class, resolution relationship and requiredness remain open.

actor-source-support.definition: A record-local provenance attribution on a source-support record. Four populated pilot records record codex-cc with extractor and agent-direct labels, but the exact support activity and principal identity remain unsettled.
actor-source-support.applicability: Only the source-support record actor and its revision; not the supported claim actor, source author, source subject, semantic verifier or truth authority.
actor-source-support.observed: The template has object/null actor. Four Arc07 pilot support records have actor.id codex-cc, mode agent-direct and role extractor, each with a claim subject_ref, ccn-book source_ref and run-arc07-s02-pilot run_ref.

operational_consequences.reader: Render the exact label, role/mode and support-record context; do not call it source authorship, verification or authority.
operational_consequences.extractor: Keep actor separate from subject_ref, source_ref, prepared source, run, evidence grade and verification state.
operational_consequences.query: Use actor as a record/revision-scoped observation; require separate evidence before joining to a principal or supported-claim actor.
operational_consequences.migration: Preserve codex-cc spelling and family/context; do not normalize it or inherit it into claims.

unresolved_questions: Does codex-cc identify a session, process, model, tool, composite or another actor class?
What direct evidence would connect this support-record actor to the run actor, source author or semantic verifier?
actor-source-support.disposition: Preserve exact populated labels and template null state; no global actor ontology or authority mapping is adopted.

actor-validation-result.definition: A record-local provenance attribution associated with a validation result; the selected template does not identify whether it is the validator, recorder or another participant.
actor-validation-result.applicability: Only the validation-result record actor; not validator_identity, target identity, contract, checks or semantic verification.
actor-validation-result.observed: The only selected mapping is the validation-result template with object/null actor and a separate null validator_identity.

operational_consequences.reader: Display actor and validator_identity as separate unassessed fields.
operational_consequences.extractor: Do not fill actor from validator_identity or target refs without direct evidence.
operational_consequences.query: Query record actor and validator identity independently and scope each to the result revision.
operational_consequences.migration: Preserve separate slots and object/null states; no precedence or equality is inferred.

unresolved_questions: Is actor intended to identify the validation performer, result recorder or another participant?
What evidence would establish a relationship between actor.id and validator_identity?
actor-validation-result.disposition: Template-only bounded finding; activity, relation to validator_identity, identity class and requiredness remain open.

actor.id-memory-admission.definition: The identity child within a memory-admission actor mapping. The selected values are null in the template and not applicable when the synthetic example omits actor.
actor.id-memory-admission.applicability: Nested actor.id only; root record id, decision authority, operator acceptance and target refs remain distinct.
actor.id-memory-admission.observed: One template object has actor.id null; one synthetic example has no actor parent.

operational_consequences.reader: Distinguish null child from absent parent; do not display a fabricated admission principal.
operational_consequences.extractor: Require direct actor evidence before filling the child.
operational_consequences.query: A null child match is not a match for records whose parent is absent.
operational_consequences.migration: Preserve both states and do not derive identity from authority or acceptance.

unresolved_questions: What identity authority, if any, makes an admission actor comparable across revisions?
actor.id-memory-admission.disposition: Retain null versus not-applicable; no identity or requiredness rule is adopted.

actor.id-preservation-decision.definition: The identity child within a preservation-decision actor mapping; the selected state is the template null placeholder.
actor.id-preservation-decision.applicability: Nested actor.id only; prior/destination and operator-review references are not actor identity.
actor.id-preservation-decision.observed: The only selected preservation-decision mapping has actor.id null.

operational_consequences.reader: Show actor identity as unassessed rather than naming a preservation decider.
operational_consequences.extractor: Keep identity separate from prior/destination and operator-acceptance references.
operational_consequences.query: Scope any future actor.id lookup to the preservation-decision revision.
operational_consequences.migration: Carry null without converting it to absent, operator, or source-author identity.

unresolved_questions: What direct evidence distinguishes the actor from an operator reviewer or decision authority?
actor.id-preservation-decision.disposition: Retain the null child; identity authority and requiredness remain unresolved.

actor.id-relationship-edge.definition: The identity child within a relationship-edge actor mapping; the selected values are null in the template and not applicable when the synthetic edge omits actor.
actor.id-relationship-edge.applicability: Nested actor.id only; endpoints, direction, symmetry and edge support remain independent.
actor.id-relationship-edge.observed: One template object has actor.id null; one synthetic relationship edge has no actor parent.

operational_consequences.reader: Keep actor identity separate from endpoints and relation direction.
operational_consequences.extractor: Do not copy from_ref, to_ref or support IDs into actor.id.
operational_consequences.query: An endpoint identity match is not an actor identity match.
operational_consequences.migration: Preserve null versus parent absence and avoid reciprocal or inherited actor values.

unresolved_questions: What event and identity authority would make an edge actor comparable across revisions?
actor.id-relationship-edge.disposition: Retain null versus not-applicable; no endpoint or support authority is inferred.

actor.id-source-locator.definition: The identity child within a source-locator actor mapping; the selected state is the template null placeholder.
actor.id-source-locator.applicability: Nested actor.id only; source/resource/locator and prepared mapping identities remain separate.
actor.id-source-locator.observed: The only selected source-locator mapping has actor.id null.

operational_consequences.reader: Show locator actor identity as unassessed.
operational_consequences.extractor: Do not derive actor.id from source_ref, resource or locator coordinates.
operational_consequences.query: Separate address/resource resolution from actor identity lookup.
operational_consequences.migration: Preserve null and any future record-local label without source-author mapping.

unresolved_questions: What evidence establishes the identity of a locator inspector, recorder or resolver?
actor.id-source-locator.disposition: Retain the null child; identity class, resolution relationship and requiredness remain unresolved.

actor.id-source-support.definition: The recorded actor label child on four candidate pilot source-support records. All four populated values are codex-cc; the selected template contributes the null state.
actor.id-source-support.applicability: Nested source-support actor.id only; not subject_ref, source_ref, run_ref, source author, verifier or truth authority.
actor.id-source-support.observed: Four populated source-support records carry codex-cc; the source-support template carries actor.id null.

operational_consequences.reader: Render codex-cc as a bounded record label with its role/mode and revision context.
operational_consequences.extractor: Keep actor.id separate from supported subject, source, run and lifecycle actors.
operational_consequences.query: Do not perform a global principal join on equal labels alone.
operational_consequences.migration: Preserve exact spelling and record family; do not map codex-cc to source authorship or verification.

unresolved_questions: Are equal codex-cc labels comparable across support records or only local session labels?
What evidence would permit a migration mapping to another actor label?
actor.id-source-support.disposition: Preserve exact label and context; no principal equivalence, authority or requiredness is adopted.

actor.id-validation-result.definition: The identity child within a validation-result actor mapping; the selected state is the template null placeholder.
actor.id-validation-result.applicability: Nested actor.id only; validator_identity, target refs and contract refs remain distinct.
actor.id-validation-result.observed: The only selected validation-result mapping has actor.id null.

operational_consequences.reader: Keep actor identity and validator identity visibly separate and unassessed.
operational_consequences.extractor: Do not fill actor.id from validator_identity or a target record.
operational_consequences.query: Scope actor.id and validator_identity lookups independently to the result revision.
operational_consequences.migration: Preserve null and avoid inventing precedence or equality.

unresolved_questions: What evidence connects, or keeps distinct, the result actor and validator_identity?
actor.id-validation-result.disposition: Retain the null child; identity relation and requiredness remain unresolved.
